row.notes: Rebuilds the owner perk trees from the game database. If the owner team id at +0x478 is unset (+0x47a==0x3fff) it fetches the player identity via g_Game_Manager (+0x140, +0x198, +0x1c0 vfunc +0x38) and matches it against the entrant array at (+0x278)+0x2e0..+0x2e8 to copy team_stat_id. Then opens table career.owner_perks (row type OwnerPerkTree); for each row hashes the xor-decoded type string (lowercase FNV-1a) to a tree kind 0/1/2, opens the child table of OwnerPerkNode rows, and for each node allocates a 0x88-byte perk object (statId at +0xc, owner data from +0x458/+0x460/+0x478), registers it on g_Game_MessageBus (FUN_1410d0a90) and inits it from the row (FUN_142ea8070). The shared-pointer vector of nodes is stored in the hash map at +0x290 keyed by tree kind. Good hook point for adding or altering owner perks. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): agree.
